synthesis.body: When a case asserts behaviour that branches on an environment variable, build the child's env explicitly and CLEAR the keys under test — `env={**os.environ, **extra}` inherits whatever CI sets. A case asserting the not-in-CI branch then takes the in-CI branch on the runner and fails there while passing on every laptop. Seen with GITHUB_WORKFLOW: the case set only SKIP_SAST, inherited the runner's real GITHUB_WORKFLOW, and took the wrong branch. Pin the scrub with one case that sets the variables ambient and asserts the declared branch still wins.

title: A test that shells out with os.environ inherits CI's variables and passes only locally
